title: MDETERM shares the LU elimination with MINVERSE and has no numeric evidence
status_plain: MDETERM has NO numeric comparison against Excel and no counted comparison of any kind. The catalogue's G5 group holds exactly one row and it is MINVERSE. The 2026-07-10 recon corpus has two G5-01-minverse rows and zero MDETERM rows. smart-fuzzer/work/w109/ has G5-01 files for MINVERSE only. The W109 lane survey names MDETERM only as adjacent, observing that its determinant_kernel already implements the exact Doolittle forward elimination MINVERSE needed - and that is a statement about OxFunc's internals, confirmed in source at matrix_family.rs:134-178 (LU forward elimination with partial pivot, determinant as the product of the pivots), not a measurement against Excel. The only Excel-versus-MDETERM evidence anywhere is one provisional structural COM probe pinning MDETERM({1,2;3,4}) -> -2, carried in a separate record. MDETERM must not inherit MINVERSE's 598/607: sharing an elimination step is not sharing a measurement, and the two surfaces publish different things from it.
substrate: crates/oxfunc_core/src/functions/matrix_family.rs:134-178 — LU forward elimination with partial pivot; the determinant is the product of the pivots. Shared with MINVERSE's inverse_kernel by construction, not by measurement.
open_question: No MDETERM-versus-Excel numeric corpus exists at any size.
reader_warning: Do not let MDETERM borrow MINVERSE's numbers. Nothing published anywhere in OxFunc scores MDETERM against Excel.
